name_zh: 斯梅特纳/立陶宛/语言/独立：语言复兴与非暴力独立
description_zh: 安塔纳斯·斯梅特纳 (1874-1944) 立陶宛总统 (1919-1920, 1926-1940)/语言/复兴/立陶宛语/禁令/沙俄/地下/出版/1918 独立/1926 政变/威权/民族/主义/苏联/占领/1940/流亡/美国/逝世/语言/非暴力/独立/遗产/斯梅特纳/立陶宛。核心模式：语言复兴非暴力独立 — 语言/禁令/地下/出版/独立/非暴力/威权/占领/遗产/斯梅特纳/立陶宛。体现 M260 语言复兴/非暴力独立 — 以"语言+禁令+地下+非暴力"四位一体，在沙俄/德国/苏联/波兰四重压迫中构建立陶宛语言复兴非暴力独立范式。
description_en: Antanas Smetona (1874-1944) Lithuania President (1919-1920, 1926-1940)/language/revival/Lithuanian/ban/Russian Empire/underground/publishing/1918 independence/1926 coup/authoritarian/nationalism/Soviet/occupation/1940/exile/USA/death/language/non-violent/independence/legacy/Smetona/Lithuania. Core model: Language Revival Non-Violent Independence — language/ban/underground/publishing/independence/non-violent/authoritarian/occupation/legacy/Smetona/Lithuania. Exemplifies M260 Language Revival/Non-Violent Independence — quaternity of 'language + ban + underground + non-violent' building Lithuanian language revival non-violent independence paradigm amid quadruple oppression of Russian Empire/Germany/Soviet Union/Poland.
reason_zh: 斯梅特纳非单纯威权领袖，而是"语言+禁令+地下+非暴力"四位一体语言民族主义者。以语言复兴奠定民族灵魂，以地下出版对抗禁令，以非暴力外交争取独立。M260 区隔于 M259 乌尔马尼斯威权(乌尔马尼斯)、M258 爱沙尼亚数字(伊尔韦斯)、M257 曼纳海姆战争(曼纳海姆)，核心在于"语言即民族灵魂+禁令即压迫镜像+地下即抵抗空间+非暴力即道德高地"的立陶宛语言复兴非暴力独立范式。
reason_en: Smetona not mere authoritarian but 'language + ban + underground + non-violent' quaternity linguistic nationalist. Language revival founded national soul, underground publishing defied ban, non-violent diplomacy secured independence. M260 distinct from M259 Ulmanis Authoritarian (Ulmanis), M258 Estonia Digital (Ilves), M257 Mannerheim War (Mannerheim), core: 'language as national soul + ban as oppression mirror + underground as resistance space + non-violent as moral high ground' Lithuanian language revival non-violent independence paradigm.
